quarterly_data.signal: e-methanol (Kassø, Denmark): Mitsui and European Energy are expanding the customer base of the e-methanol produced by Solar Park Kasso ApS, a subsidiary of their joint venture, which the companies call the world's first: the initial shipment went to A.P. Moller - Maersk in May 2025 as marine fuel; from spring 2026 the project also supplies e-methanol for chemical products to the LEGO group and Novo Nordisk; supply decisions include OMV, which will use it as an RFNBO land-transport fuel. Mitsui positions it under 'Global Energy Transformation 2.0' in its Medium-term Management Plan 2029.
